policy.default_stop: Stop after both slow_band (all three prompts <2300 tok/s) and fast_band (all three >2500), else stop at six. Retain all.
policy.sequence: Default CPU share diagnostics first, then CPU=0 ablation. CPU0 band labels are descriptive and are not a claim about an identical baseline.
policy.settings: All PROF=1 and VERBOSE=1, helperON/PROMOTE0/RESYNC0, same original trial-01 16K input repeated3 times,2K generation.
policy.host_isolation: Exclusive advisory lock plus per-process CPU/IO/RSS and GPU audits before Popen and through exit. Four preflight samples, three consecutive low global-NVMe-IO intervals. Stop only our own engine if contention is detected. No services/power/clocks/fan changes.
policy.limitations: Process-exit profiles include all three prompts including warm-up. Instrumented diagnostic, not clean performance/accuracy ranking. Two-second host audit cannot exclude all brief OS activity.

limitations: Host audit samples same-user process CPU/IO/RSS and all GPU compute PIDs every ~2 seconds, with whole-NVMe settling checks before each case; it cannot exclude every short OS event. CPU0 changes the intended prompt baseline, so band labels are descriptive. Diagnostic profiling adds CUDA events and synchronization. Every process runs three identical 16K/2K requests; the exit profiler includes the first warm-up and all subsequent prefill work. Stage event intervals are accumulated GPU stream time, may include stream stalls, and are not a pure kernel breakdown or a sum of end-to-end request wall time. This is a state-finding diagnostic selected by a predeclared rule, not an unbiased frequency estimate or a clean speed/quality comparison. Output IDs can differ; no new numerical CHECK run.
